typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		FIRST_NAME as string,
		LAST_NAME as string,
		EMAIL_ADDRESS as string,
		PHONE as string,
		CURRENT_MEMBER_YN as string,
		MEETINGID as string,
		RSVP_DATE as string,
		REQUEST_ID as string,
		PROMO_ID as string,
		PTC as string,
		PTC_SCOPE as string,
		PTC_SOURCE as string,
		PTC_DATE as string,
		PTC_EXPIRATION as string,
		PTE as string,
		PTE_SCOPE as string,
		PTE_SOURCE as string,
		PTE_DATE as string,
		PTE_EXPIRATION as string,
		CONTACT_ID as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_onlineRSVP*']) ~> onlineRSVP
addADFId split(isNull(CURRENT_MEMBER_YN)||isNull(MEETINGID)||isNull(RSVP_DATE)||isNull(REQUEST_ID)||isNull(PROMO_ID)||((isNull(CONTACT_ID) == false()) && not(in(['003', '00Q'], upper(substring(CONTACT_ID, 1, 3)))))||(length(PHONE)!=10)||((isNull(RSVP_DATE) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(RSVP_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd HH:mm:ss'))))||((isNull(PTC_DATE) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(PTC_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'))))||((isNull(PTC_EXPIRATION) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(PTC_EXPIRATION, 'yyyyMMdd'))))||((isNull(PTE_DATE) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(PTE_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'))))||((isNull(PTE_DATE) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(PTE_EXPIRATION, 'yyyyMMdd')))),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(rejectCONDITION, toSFDC)
ConditionalSplit1@rejectCONDITION derive(REJECT_REASON = concat(iif(isNull(CURRENT_MEMBER_YN)||isNull(MEETINGID)||isNull(RSVP_DATE)||isNull(REQUEST_ID)||isNull(PROMO_ID), concat('ADF:REQUIRED FIELD MISSING: ', iif(isNull(CURRENT_MEMBER_YN), 'Are you a KP member ', ''), iif(isNull(MEETINGID), 'Meeting ID ', ''), iif(isNull(RSVP_DATE), 'RSVP Date ', ''), iif(isNull(REQUEST_ID), 'Request ID ', ''), iif(isNull(PROMO_ID), 'Promo ID ', '')), ''),
       iif(((isNull(CONTACT_ID) == false()) && not(in(['003', '00Q'], upper(substring(CONTACT_ID, 1, 3))))), concat('ADF:INVALID Contact ID: Contact ID should begin with 003 or 00Q. Received Contact ID: ', CONTACT_ID), ''),
       iif(length(PHONE) != 10, 'ADF:Invalid Phone Number Length',''),
       iif((isNull(RSVP_DATE) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(RSVP_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd HH:mm:ss'))), 'ADF:Invalid RSVP Date Format, ', ''),
       iif((isNull(PTC_DATE) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(PTC_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'))), 'ADF:Invalid PTC Date Format, ', ''),
       iif((isNull(PTC_EXPIRATION) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(PTC_EXPIRATION, 'yyyyMMdd'))), 'ADF:Invalid PTC Expiration Date Format, ', ''),
       iif((isNull(PTE_DATE) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(PTE_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd'))), 'ADF:Invalid PTE Date Format, ', ''),
       iif((isNull(PTC_DATE) == false())&&(isNull(toTimestamp(PTC_EXPIRATION, 'yyyyMMdd'))), 'ADF:Invalid PTE_Expiration Date Format, ', ''), 
       '')) ~> rejectREASON
rejectREASON select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
ConditionalSplit2@hasContactId select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Email__c = EMAIL_ADDRESS,
		KPMember__c = CURRENT_MEMBER_YN,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call__c = PTC,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email__c = PTE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		Meeting__c = MEETINGID,
		Phone_Number__c = PHONE,
		Promo_ID__c = PROMO_ID,
		PTC_Expiration__c = PTC_EXPIRATION,
		PTC_Scope__c = PTC_SCOPE,
		PTC_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c = PTC_DATE,
		PTE__c = PTE,
		PTE_Expiration__c = PTE_EXPIRATION,
		PTE_Scope__c = PTE_SCOPE,
		PTE_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		PTE_Modified_Date__c = PTE_DATE,
		Name = FIRST_NAME,
		Registrant_last_Name__c = LAST_NAME,
		RSVP_Date__c = RSVP_DATE,
		Request_Id__c = REQUEST_ID,
		Contact__c = CONTACT_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> toMtgAttendContact
ConditionalSplit2@hasContactId select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		FirstName = FIRST_NAME,
		LastName = LAST_NAME,
		Email = EMAIL_ADDRESS,
		Home_Phone__c = PHONE,
		KPMember__c = CURRENT_MEMBER_YN,
		Promo_Id__c = PHONE,
		PTC__c = PTC,
		PTC_Scope__c = PTC_SCOPE,
		PTC_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c = PTC_DATE,
		PTC_Expiration__c = PTC_EXPIRATION,
		PTE__c = PTE,
		PTE_Scope__c = PTE_SCOPE,
		PTE_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		PTE_Modified_Date__c = PTE_DATE,
		PTE_Expiration__c = PTE_EXPIRATION,
		Id = CONTACT_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> toLead
ConditionalSplit2@noContactId select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Email__c = EMAIL_ADDRESS,
		KPMember__c = CURRENT_MEMBER_YN,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call__c = PTC,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email__c = PTE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		Meeting__c = MEETINGID,
		Phone_Number__c = PHONE,
		Promo_ID__c = PROMO_ID,
		PTC_Expiration__c = PTC_EXPIRATION,
		PTC_Scope__c = PTC_SCOPE,
		PTC_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c = PTC_DATE,
		PTE__c = PTE,
		PTE_Expiration__c = PTE_EXPIRATION,
		PTE_Scope__c = PTE_SCOPE,
		PTE_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		PTE_Modified_Date__c = PTE_DATE,
		Name = FIRST_NAME,
		Registrant_last_Name__c = LAST_NAME,
		RSVP_Date__c = RSVP_DATE,
		Request_Id__c = REQUEST_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
toContact filter(startsWith(Id, '003')) ~> FilterContact1
toLead filter(startsWith(Id, '00Q')) ~> FilterLead1
toMtgAttendContact filter(startsWith(Contact__c, '003')) ~> FilterContact2
toMtgAttendLead filter(startsWith(Lead__c, '00Q')) ~> FilterLead2
ConditionalSplit2@hasContactId select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Email__c = EMAIL_ADDRESS,
		KPMember__c = CURRENT_MEMBER_YN,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call__c = PTC,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Call_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email__c = PTE,
		Medicare_Permission_to_Email_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		Meeting__c = MEETINGID,
		Phone_Number__c = PHONE,
		Promo_ID__c = PROMO_ID,
		PTC_Expiration__c = PTC_EXPIRATION,
		PTC_Scope__c = PTC_SCOPE,
		PTC_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c = PTC_DATE,
		PTE__c = PTE,
		PTE_Expiration__c = PTE_EXPIRATION,
		PTE_Scope__c = PTE_SCOPE,
		PTE_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		PTE_Modified_Date__c = PTE_DATE,
		Name = FIRST_NAME,
		Registrant_last_Name__c = LAST_NAME,
		RSVP_Date__c = RSVP_DATE,
		Request_Id__c = REQUEST_ID,
		Lead__c = CONTACT_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> toMtgAttendLead
Select2, FilterContact2, FilterLead2 union(byName: true)~> Union1
ConditionalSplit2@hasContactId select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		FirstName = FIRST_NAME,
		LastName = LAST_NAME,
		Email = EMAIL_ADDRESS,
		HomePhone = PHONE,
		KPMember__c = CURRENT_MEMBER_YN,
		Promo_Id__c = PROMO_ID,
		PTC__c = PTC,
		PTC_Scope__c = PTC_SCOPE,
		PTC_Source__c = PTC_SOURCE,
		PTC_Modified_Date__c = PTC_DATE,
		PTC_Expiration__c = PTC_EXPIRATION,
		PTE__c = PTE,
		PTE_Scope__c = PTE_SCOPE,
		PTE_Source__c = PTE_SOURCE,
		PTE_Modified_Date__c = PTE_DATE,
		PTE_Expiration__c = PTE_EXPIRATION,
		Id = CONTACT_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> toContact
onlineRSVP derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> addADFId
DerivedColumn1 split(isNull(CONTACT_ID),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit2@(noContactId, hasContactId)
ConditionalSplit1@toSFDC derive(CURRENT_MEMBER_YN = iif(upper(CURRENT_MEMBER_YN) == 'Y', 'Yes', concat(iif(upper(CURRENT_MEMBER_YN) == 'N', 'No', CURRENT_MEMBER_YN))),
		RSVP_DATE = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(RSVP_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd HH:mm:ss')),RSVP_DATE),
		PTC_DATE = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(PTC_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')),PTC_DATE),
		PTC_EXPIRATION = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(PTC_EXPIRATION, 'yyyyMMdd')),PTC_EXPIRATION),
		PTE_DATE = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(PTE_DATE, 'yyyyMMdd')),PTE_DATE),
		PTE_EXPIRATION = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(PTE_EXPIRATION, 'yyyyMMdd')),PTE_DATE)) ~> DerivedColumn1
addADFId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_onlineRSVP_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> intermOUTPUT
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_onlineRSVP_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> rejectOUTPUT
FilterContact1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_onlineRSVP_Contact.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertContact
FilterLead1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_onlineRSVP_Lead.csv')],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> upsertLead
Union1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_onlineRSVP_Staging_Meeting_Attendee__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertMtgAttendee
